units.source_text: 离开京都时，我有一种意气风发的精神，如今却又被导向对故人们的追忆。

en.t: When I left Kyoto, I was filled with a kind of high-spirited resolve, but now I was being led back into memories of those who were gone.

units.source_text: 对有为子、父亲和鹤川的怀念，在我内心中唤起了无法形容的亲切感，

en.t: Longing for Uiko, my father, and Tsurukawa awakened in me an indescribable feeling of intimacy,

units.source_text: 我怀疑自己是否只能把故人当做活人来爱呢？

en.t: and I wondered whether I could love the dead only by treating them as though they were still alive.

units.source_text: 抑或是古人比起活人来，有一到更加容易把人喜爱的形象呢！

en.t: Or could it be that the people of the past, more than the living, possess a form that makes them easier to love?
